headline: Public docs teardown: highest-impact fixes and the automation layer to prioritize first

summary.executive_summary: Depot.dev documentation audit covered 531 pages with 100% crawl coverage and 91.5% overall confidence. API reference coverage is 64.11% across 38 detected API pages, leaving roughly one-third of API surface undocumented. SEO/geo issue rate is elevated at 19.44%, impacting discoverability. Retrieval readiness scores 66.04/100 (moderate band), with chunkability at only 22.03% indicating poor AI answer quality. Example reliability detection returned 0% across all 531 pages, flagging a likely JS-rendered code block detection limitation. Evidence coverage is 75.18% (521 of 693 claims backed), and 2 confirmed broken internal links exist in user-facing docs.

key_findings.headline: Undocumented API operations
key_findings.business_consequence: Generate/update reference + how-to from OpenAPI and enforce drift checks.

key_findings.headline: Code examples fail or are non-runnable
key_findings.business_consequence: Run smoke + expected-output checks and auto-fix broken snippets.

key_findings.headline: Code/docs contract drift
key_findings.business_consequence: Track interface changes and enforce docs updates with report-first governance.

priority_actions.title: Improve chunkability from 22.03% to >70% by adding semantic section breaks, headings, and list structures to long-form pages
priority_actions.why_this_first: Chunkability directly controls AI answer quality and LLM retrieval success, affecting every AI-assisted user interaction and support deflection opportunity.

priority_actions.title: Resolve 19.44% SEO/geo issues (~103 pages) by adding missing meta descriptions, fixing title tags, and ensuring proper heading hierarchy
priority_actions.why_this_first: SEO fixes deliver immediate organic traffic gains and improve top-of-funnel discoverability with minimal engineering effort.

priority_actions.title: Close API reference coverage gap from 64.11% to >90% by documenting missing endpoints, parameters, and response schemas across the 38 detected API pages
priority_actions.why_this_first: Incomplete API docs drive developer support tickets, slow onboarding, and increase trial-to-paid friction for technical buyers.

strengths: 100% crawl coverage (531 of 531 pages) with high crawl confidence (95%)
Actionability coverage at 95%, indicating strong task-oriented content
Answerability and citationability both at 100%, supporting AI retrieval use cases
risks: API reference coverage at 64.11% leaves ~36% of API surface undocumented, risking developer churn and support load
Chunkability at 22.03% severely limits LLM context window efficiency and answer quality in AI-assisted workflows
SEO/geo issue rate of 19.44% (approximately 103 pages) reduces organic discoverability and search ranking
Example reliability detection at 0% across 531 pages suggests JS-rendered code blocks invisible to crawlers and LLM scrapers
limitations: External audit cannot verify runtime accuracy of code examples, API responses, or CLI commands; 0% example reliability may reflect detection limits on JS-rendered content rather than true absence.
Crawl-based analysis cannot assess gated content, authenticated workflows, or dynamic user-specific documentation paths.
Metrics reflect structural and surface-level signals; actual user comprehension, task success rates, and support deflection require behavioral analytics.
automation_first: Deploy automated chunkability linter to flag pages below 70% threshold (currently 22.03% site-wide, ~414 pages affected) in CI/CD, preventing new long-form content from degrading AI retrieval and reducing manual audits by 80%.

Implement broken link checker in pre-deploy pipeline to catch the 2 confirmed broken internal links and prevent future regressions, eliminating manual link audits and preserving SEO authority flow automatically.

Add API reference coverage monitor to track the 38 detected API pages against OpenAPI spec or codebase, alerting when coverage drops below 90% (currently 64.11%) to prevent undocumented endpoints from reaching production and cutting support ticket volume.
